title: Pocketwire Rewards Training Note: The Courtesy Redemption Supplement
content:
The courtesy redemption supplement adds points to a Pocketwire Rewards courtesy credit for late fulfilment according to how many redemptions the member made over the last twelve months.

## Rule

The courtesy redemption supplement is 500 points when the ledger carries at least 4 redemptions of any kind dated within the last twelve months, 200 points when it carries at least 2 but fewer than 4, and nothing when it carries fewer than 2. The supplement is added to the courtesy credit for the late redemption, in whole points.

A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Questions answered

What is counted? Redemption entries of any kind on the member's Pocketwire Rewards points ledger: cash to the personal balance, gift cards and charity donations alike.

Four redemptions in the window? 500 points.

Two or three? 200 points.

One, or none? Nothing.

## Count and supplement

| Redemptions within the last twelve months | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 500 points |
| 2 or 3 | 200 points |
| 0 or 1 | nothing |
